entries.reason: This paper proposes a hybrid AI-driven framework for the early detection of structural irregularities in earthquake-resistant architectural design, which has the potential to significantly improve building safety and reduce damage from earthquakes.
entries.title: Hybrid AI Model for Early Detection of Structural Irregularities in Earthquake-Resistant Architectural Design
entries.paragraph: Researchers developed a hybrid AI-driven framework for detecting structural irregularities in earthquake-resistant architectural design. The system, called Irregularity Detector (ID.1), uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to analyze architectural plan images and combines this with analytical structural parameters. The model was trained on 1,576 architectural plan samples and achieved a validation accuracy of 99.2% and an F1-score of 0.98.

entries.reason: This study offers a replicable framework for seismic vulnerability assessment that integrates managerial, human, and logistical dimensions, which can help construction projects in seismic-prone regions to better prepare for and respond to earthquakes.
entries.title: Seismic vulnerability assessment of construction projects: A multi-criteria approach
entries.paragraph: Researchers applied the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to evaluate seismic vulnerability in construction projects. They used a structured multi-criteria decision-making model to assess key parameters, including human resources, materials, supply logistics, and organizational practices. The study found that human and organizational factors significantly influence overall vulnerability.

entries.reason: This research develops a new type of sambungan replaceable with a locking mechanism that can localize damage to a structural fuse without compromising the seismic performance of the structure, which could lead to significant improvements in repairability and cost-effectiveness after earthquakes.
entries.title: Analisis perilaku sambungan replaceable dengan mekanisme kuncian dan sambungan konvensional pada Sistem Rangka Baja Pemikul Momen Khusus
entries.paragraph: Researchers developed a replaceable connection with a locking mechanism for the Special Moment-Resisting Frame (SMRF) system. They evaluated the connection's performance using numerical analysis and found that it achieved a maximum capacity of 1.015,7 kN, which is 92.94% higher than the conventional connection.
